name: Is a single or double vanity better for a guest bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Is a single or double vanity better for a guest bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Single vanities preserve valuable floor space and allow room for a wider shower or dedicated linen storage, making them practical for standard 5x8-foot or compact guest bathrooms. Double vanities work best in larger shared hall bathrooms where multiple family members or guests get ready at the same time. The tradeoff with a double vanity is reduced countertop counter space and fewer lower storage drawers, so you must weigh user convenience against overall bathroom layout efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single vanity saves floor and counter space in smaller bathrooms, while a double vanity is ideal for larger, high-traffic shared bathrooms.
